craft_evidence.owned: Evidence (10-K FY2026): Air Manufacturing Innovation, a wholly-owned subsidiary with facilities near Beaverton, Oregon and elsewhere, supplies Air-Sole and other footwear cushioning components. This covers footwear parts only. No owned apparel factory: the 10-K says nearly all products are made by i
craft_evidence.makers: None on product pages (64 read). At company level, the 10-K gives counts only: 321 contract apparel factories in 34 countries and 95 footwear factories in 11. Nike also publishes a factory map (manufacturingmap.nikeinc.com), which is script-rendered and was not read.
craft_evidence.mills: None named on any of the 64 product pages read.
craft_evidence.heritage: Dated and placed, brand's own words: Blue Ribbon Sports founded on 25 January 1964 at the Cosmopolitan Hotel, Portland, Oregon, by Phil Knight and Bill Bowerman (about.nike.com, 17 Dec 2025). NIKE, In
craft_evidence.process: Claim-level only. Product pages describe what the fabric does (Dri-FIT moves sweat, Therma-FIT, Storm-FIT), not how or where the garment is made. 10-K country shares: apparel Vietnam ~34%, Cambodia ~1
craft_evidence.reasoning: Every one of the 63 non-swim product pages read says only "Imported". No page names a country, maker or mill, and the swim page has no origin line at all. The 10-K documents fully contracted production, with the apparel shares by country given above and a published factory map. The only owned making is footwear Air cushioning components. The heritage is dated and placed, but the clothing's making is not shown, so this is a borderline 2 (a 1 is arguable).
